import pandas as pd

path = 'budget.xlsx'
xls = pd.ExcelFile(path)
print("Sheets:", xls.sheet_names)
for sheet in xls.sheet_names:
    df = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=sheet, header=None)
    print(f"\n--- Sheet: {sheet} ({df.shape[0]} rows x {df.shape[1]} cols) ---")
    print(df.to_string(max_colwidth=40))

import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

NS = {'m': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'}
M = '{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}'
path = 'budget.xlsx'

with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:
    ws = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'))
    for row in ws.iter(M + 'row'):
        for c in row:
            ref = c.get('r')
            f = c.find(M + 'f')
            v = c.find(M + 'v')
            if ref in ('A8', 'B8', 'A23', 'C23', 'A25', 'B25') or f is not None:
                print(ref, '| type=', c.get('t'), '| formula=', f.text if f is not None else None,
                      '| value=', v.text if v is not None else None)

# Compute totals from parsed data
expenses = [1500, 200, 150, 350, 150, 100, 500, 200, 50, 100, 500, 400]
print("\nExpense items:", expenses)
print("Total expenses:", sum(expenses))
income = [5000, 800, 250, 100]
print("Income items:", income)
print("Total income:", sum(income))
print("Balance:", sum(income) - sum(expenses))
